generated_in_code.music: Synthesized in code (src/audio.py): detuned-saw drone on D/A, sub pulse, and a riser before the resignation reveal.
generated_in_code.sfx: Synthesized in code (src/audio.py): whoosh, paper slap, typewriter clicks, stamp hit, glitch, sub hit.
generated_in_code.narration: AI-generated with Kokoro-82M (hexgrad/Kokoro-82M, Apache-2.0), voice af_heart, speed 1.2.

not_used: No video or audio from YouTube, TikTok, X, news sites, TV, films or podcasts.
No news-agency photos (Getty, AP, Reuters, AFP).
No screenshots of articles. The SEC 8-K is a typographic recreation, because sec.gov returned HTTP 403 to this environment.
No Pexels/Pixabay stock (no API keys set).
